title: StS Vim
description:
Play Slay the Spire 2 from the keyboard with vim keys. Uses the game's own controller navigation; no gameplay changes. Controller button prompts show the key to press instead.

h j k l - move focus
Space / Enter - select
Esc / Ctrl-[ - cancel, pause when nothing to cancel
e - end turn
1-0 - select card
H / L - tab left / right
p - potions and relics (then j for relics)
v - peek
gm gd ga gs gx - map, deck, draw, discard, exhaust

Moving the mouse switches back to mouse mode. Plugging in a gamepad restores gamepad prompts.
